contracts: Selector 0x61 creates a four-position Type-0x40 set when INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS equals ASCII 00, using the established Type-0x40 helper at the base, X+0x0C, Y-0x0A, and base-again positions.
Selector 0xAD requires INTERACTION_GATE_TYPE40 and then falls through to the selector-0x60 Type-0x40 body.

Selector 0x60 suppresses the spawn for INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS == ASCII 99; otherwise it creates runtime type 0x40 from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_BASE_ZERO, installs ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE40_INTERACTION, and clears actor byte +0x29.
evidence: Existing Type-0x40 helper, template, animation, and gate symbols
limitations: No user-facing object identity is claimed for the Type-0x40 actors.
The counter and gate bytes retain their established conservative state names.
conclusion: The Type-0x40 interaction family now has stable single-actor, four-position, and gated-wrapper creation identities while preserving historical aliases.
